title: Conversation corrections reach editable setup without stale actions or overwritten edits
steps: Run tests/regression/scripts/REG-PR-5-chat-flexible-onboarding.mjs against the current checkout; it uses the real wizard, bridge and CSS with deterministic API fixtures and closes its own browsers and servers.
expect: The latest settled revision and most recent action click win; pending corrections prevent a stale handoff.
Untouched chat prefills update, while manual edits and deliberate clears survive new chat drafts and tab remounts.
Corrected import and business seeds invalidate previous checks and search results before an operation starts.
No site is created before the final customer confirmation.
